Garbage Room.intro:
The door creaks open. The smell hits you immediately.

Piles of garbage cover the floor, slowly decomposing in the darkness. A strange green mist hangs in the air.

Storage Room.intro:
The storage room is strangely quiet.

Boxes are stacked from floor to ceiling, but something feels wrong. Every surface is covered in a thin layer of black dust.

You hear a deep, rhythmic breathing from behind the shelves.

A hulking creature emerges, dragging chains of old fuel canisters behind it.

It looks at you and clutches its hoard of carbon closer.

The Carbon Hoarder blocks your path.
Storage Room.victory: Its carbon hoard crumbles to the floor as the monster lets out one final roar.
Storage Room.loss: The Carbon Hoarder tightens its grip. You become part of its growing collection.

Bathroom.intro:
The lights flicker as you enter.

Water drips from a broken pipe. The sinks overflow, even though nobody is using them.

Locker Room.intro:
The locker doors slam shut one by one.

You stop.

Something is breathing heavily on the other side of the room.

A locker suddenly bursts open.

A massive creature steps out, its body glowing like burning coal. Smoke pours from its mouth with every breath.

The Combustion Brute challenges you.
Locker Room.victory: The Brute's flames die out, leaving only a smoking heap on the floor.
Locker Room.loss: A burst of heat knocks you back. The Brute's flames consume the room.

Security Room.intro:
The security monitors flash red.

One by one, the cameras shut down.

A low mechanical rumble fills the room.

From behind the security desk rises a towering machine covered in pipes and exhaust vents. Thick smoke pours from its metal body.

Its red eyes lock onto you.

The Diesel Sentinel has identified its next target.
Security Room.victory: The Sentinel sparks and shuts down. The smoke slowly clears.
Security Room.loss: The Sentinel's engine roars. Thick exhaust fills the room as your vision fades.

Office Room.intro:
The office looks abandoned.

Computers are still running. Lights are still on. Printers hum despite nobody being there.

Then every screen suddenly goes black.

Something crawls across the ceiling.

A strange creature drops onto the desk, its body glowing brighter as it feeds on the electricity around it.

The lights begin to flicker.

The Energy Leech is feeding.
Office Room.victory: The Leech releases its grip on the power grid and shrivels into darkness.
Office Room.loss: The lights flicker out one by one. The Energy Leech drains the last of your strength.

Operations Room.intro:
You enter the operations room.

Unlike the other rooms, this one is still running.

Machines roar. Warning lights flash. Pipes shake under immense pressure.

At the center of the room stands a towering creature engulfed in flames and black smoke.

The air itself seems to burn around it.

It turns toward you.

The monitors display a single warning

CRITICAL CO2 EMISSIONS

The creature lets out a deafening roar.

CARBON INFERNO HAS AWAKENED.

This is where the emissions end.

Or where you do.
Operations Room.victory: The flames disappear. The machines fall silent. The CO₂ levels begin to drop.
Operations Room.loss: Carbon Inferno erupts in flames. The alarms scream as the room disappears beneath a cloud of smoke.
